name: 29307 · Spartanburg, SC
findings: ZIP 29307 (Spartanburg) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29307 (Spartanburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
